full_track.tags: Contemporary K-Pop R&B ballad. Smooth male tenor vocals with light vibrato and breathy delivery. Electric piano plays jazz-influenced seventh chords with a soft attack. A fretless bass guitar performs melodic slides and syncopated fills. Minimalist percussion consists of a crisp rimshot on the backbeat and a subtle shaker. A clean electric guitar provides occasional muted staccato plucks. The arrangement features lush vocal harmonies and layered backing tracks during the chorus. Key of E Major. Tempo is 72 BPM.
